method: Bounded original enumeration/growth/quicksort with controlled Win32 enumeration and heap; exact bytes and endpoint calls compared
return_contract: 0041c740 and 0041c8f0 return Boolean in AL; upper EAX bits are unspecified and are not compared.

safety_difference.reason: Remove the original duplicate deletion of an offsets buffer when growing a reused non-appending list. All final data bytes remain equal.

limitations: Enumeration and allocation endpoints are controlled. File reads, actual OS directory ordering and campaign/save parsing are separate checks.
The legacy file-list vtable remains data; no original machine code is called.
